label: Basic
description: Basic stepper. Best for a row of 4 numbered circles whose connector takes the primary colour after each passed step.

label: Completed State
description: Stepper with completed state. Best for passed steps painted green on both the circle and its connector, with later numbers in gray.

label: Loading State
description: Stepper with a loading step. Best for number free ring markers: a dot marks the current step, a spinner the loading one and a check each passed step.

label: Controlled
description: Controlled stepper. Best for the active step kept in state and moved by Previous and Next buttons that disable at either end.

label: Labels Below
description: Stepper with title and indicator. Best for numbered circles that become checks once passed, each with a short label centered below it.

label: Left Aligned Titles
description: Stepper with titles beside the markers. Best for numbers beside bold titles from User details to Preview form, with connectors that never fill.

label: Icons & Badges
description: Stepper with icons and badges. Best for icon markers beside a Step N line, a bold title and an In progress, Completed or Pending badge.

label: Descriptions
description: Stepper with descriptions. Best for centered steps stacking a number, a title and a one line description, with connectors between them.

label: Inline Titles
description: Stepper with inline titles. Best for a number or check beside each title in one row, with a connector that fills once the step is passed.

label: Title & Caption
description: Stepper with content for each step. Best for a number or check beside a 2 line title and caption per step, joined by muted connectors that never fill.

label: Bar With Titles
description: Stepper with progress bar and titles. Best for full width bar segments, one per step, filling with the primary color up to the current one, titles below.

label: Segmented Bar
description: Segmented bar stepper. Best for one thick bar of 4 joined segments, a Back link, a current of total counter and a Next button.

label: Vertical Descriptions
description: Stepper with vertical orientation and descriptions. Best for a top to bottom column of numbered markers, each with a title and a description beside it, links greening once done.

label: Vertical
description: Stepper with vertical orientation. Best for a bare column of 3 numbered circles with green links between finished ones and a spinner on the loading step.

label: Vertical Titles
description: Vertical titles. Best for vertical numbered steps labelled with one title each, the step's content centred below.

label: Delivery Stops
description: Delivery stops with times. Best for a route of stops with their times, a spinner on the current stop, and Previous and Next.

label: Dotted Progress
description: Dotted progress. Best for tiny ring dots joined by dotted links in a box at most 240 pt wide, each named for screen readers.

label: Stage Details
description: Stages with details. Best for a stage row above a sideways scrolling row of stage cards, each listing label and value pairs.

label: Frame Icon Tiles
description: Icon tile steps over a panel. Best for icon tiles split by chevrons above a placeholder panel, with Previous and Next.

label: Purchase Orders
description: Purchase orders. Best for a list of orders with Ready or Review badges and an actions menu for the active order.

label: Security Checks
description: Grouped security checks. Best for areas in an outlined accordion, each holding its own numbered checks, with a status badge per area.

label: Bottom Color Bars
description: Colour bars under the content. Best for step tabs as bar segments under the content panel, finished ones in green.

label: Top Color Bars
description: Colour bars over card art. Best for bar segment tabs across the top of a card entry flow, over the card's artwork.

label: Icon Tile Rows
description: Icon tile rows. Best for stacked rows pressable edge to edge, each with an icon tile and a status marker at its end, above a Step N of 4 line.

label: Phase Track
description: Phase track. Best for a bar where only the reached phases fill, a spinner on the current one, and refund case copy below.

label: Timestamped Checkpoints
description: Timestamped checkpoints. Best for a bar of checkpoints whose times show only once reached.

label: Transit Arrow
description: Transit stops. Best for times on passed stops and estimates for the rest, as rings down a line.

label: Breadcrumb Steps
description: Breadcrumb steps. Best for text only step names in a trail beside an Onboarding label and a step counter.

label: Compact Inline
description: Compact inline progress. Best for ring markers with names beside them, the current one spinning and done ones ticked.

label: Truck Route
description: Truck route with rest stops. Best for icon stops with times and rest breaks, a green line once passed, with Previous and Next.

label: Chevron Icon Tiles
description: Icon tiles with chevrons. Best for a row of icon tile steps split by chevron icons.

label: Numbered Chevrons
description: Numbered chevron stages. Best for chevron shaped stages that read as one arrow, the current one filled.

label: Filled Chevrons
description: Filled chevrons on a dark strip. Best for an inverse strip of chevrons showing only glyphs, the current one filled.

label: Outlined Chevrons
description: Chevron plan with a count. Best for chevrons across the width after a Plan 2 of 4 done chip.

label: Flat Chevrons
description: Flat chevron plan. Best for a contract plan as 3 chevrons, the first one current.

label: Shipping Route
description: Shipping route. Best for ports with their roles and dates, a spinner on the current leg and estimates for the rest.

label: Horizontal Step Cards
description: Step cards in a grid. Best for cards that are the tabs themselves, in a 2 column grid above the chosen step's detail.

label: Shipment Progress
description: Shipment progress. Best for icon markers under a line that turns green once passed.

label: Vertical Step Cards
description: Step cards in a column. Best for stacked tab cards in a 240 pt column above the chosen step's detail.

label: Side Rail Icons
description: Side rail with step icons. Best for a glyph per row that fills when reached, and a green check on finished rows.

label: Status List
description: Status list. Best for a narrow rail of rings whose current one spins, beside the titles.

label: Vertical Status Bars
description: Vertical status bars. Best for a bar per row that fills once reached, beside each title and description.

label: Collapsible Sub-Steps
description: Phases with sub-steps. Best for numbered phases with a turning chevron, the open one holding its own task steps.

label: Right-Aligned Sub-Steps
description: Segmented vertical rail. Best for thick segments down the side of each step's title and description.
